facts.text: The hotel has welcomed guests since 1934 in a palace built as a private villa in 1918.
facts.excerpt: It has welcomed guests since 1934, in a palace built as a private villa in 1918.

facts.text: The Palacete is the original 1918 villa, built for the canning industrialist Antonio Judice de Magalhaes Barros.

facts.text: The hotel occupies three houses above the beach: the Palacete, Casa Azul facing the Atlantic and Casa Jardim opening onto the garden.
facts.excerpt: Casa Azul faces the Atlantic; Casa Jardim opens onto the garden.

facts.text: The hotel occupies three houses above the beach.

facts.text: Bela Vista sits on the clifftop at Praia da Rocha in Portimao, in the Algarve.

facts.text: The Palacete's style blends Portuguese heritage with oriental echoes in warm tones, deep blues and golden details.
facts.excerpt: The style blends Portuguese heritage with oriental echoes in warm tones, deep blues and golden details.

facts.text: Palacete rooms have antique colors, oil-painted details and painted ceilings.
facts.excerpt: In the Palacete, antique colors and oil-painted details preserve the soul of the house. Golden tones and painted ceilings

facts.text: In Casa Jardim, wardrobes and details are inspired by old fishermen's houses, and walls alternate between shades of blue and green.
facts.excerpt: The wardrobes and details are inspired by the old fishermen’s houses

facts.text: Casa Azul faces the Atlantic and is the sunniest part of the hotel.
facts.excerpt: It is the sunniest part of the hotel.

facts.text: The hotel has an outdoor pool with a panoramic view.
facts.excerpt: Outdoor pool with panoramic view.

facts.text: The spa is a Spa by L'Occitane.

facts.text: The spa has treatment rooms for couples, a sauna, a steam bath and a wet relaxation area with a plunge pool.
facts.excerpt: The spa includes five treatment rooms (two dedicated to couples), a sauna, a steam bath, and a wet relaxation area with a plunge pool.

facts.text: Guests have access to a fully equipped gym with ocean views.

facts.text: Guests can go on a fishing trip with Chef Joao Oliveira that ends with a fresh meal; it is subject to sea and weather conditions.
facts.excerpt: An intimate and memorable experience: embark on a fishing trip with Chef João Oliveira. A journey that blends the thrill of the sea with culinary artistry, ending with a fresh meal prepared to your taste.

facts.text: Guests can explore the Algarve coast aboard a private yacht, admiring caves and cliffs.

facts.text: Guests can join pottery-making workshops guided by local Algarve artisans.

facts.text: An oyster experience includes a guided visit to local oyster farms and a tasting with regional wines.

facts.text: At Vista restaurant, fish and seafood arrive daily from Algarve ports.
